## Control Objective

What accounting, inventory, WIP, work-order, purchase, or audit risk should this rule pack address?

## Source Files

Which ReconForge canonical files are required?

## Example Rules

Describe the rules in plain English before suggesting YAML.

## Expected Exceptions

What should be flagged when the control fails?

## Evidence Needed

Which fields should be copied into evidence outputs?

## Sanitized Sample

Attach only synthetic or anonymized examples. Do not attach live ERP data.

## Acceptance Criteria

How should maintainers validate the rule pack?
